prompt:
Create ONE design variant sheet for a prop of a silent hand-drawn animated film. Pure black field (#000000), flat shapes in five roles only (main1, main2, shadow, light, accent), thin pale contour one step lighter than each fill with tapered tips, shadow as a designed shape with two-scale stipple (never a smooth gradient), no text, no labels, no UI, no gradients, no photographic texture, no black outline. Colour script of the shot: deep blues with cream light and one scarce yellow accent #fad204 (radiance blue #0a51fb). The design must separate into movable parts on the black field (each part a closed flat shape) so it can be cut and moved later.
ASSET: the bubble: capability seen through glass; it swells out of the box, holds a small world with rays, and pops; hand-coded today in Bubble.tsx.
LAYOUT: Show the SAME bubble in three states on one baseline: small and whole, swollen with the small world inside, and the burst ring with flying fragments. 16:9 sheet.
REFERENCE ROLES (each image supplies only the property named; do not copy any of them):
Image 1: owner card MFIYY3RT6SJS2: a radial burst with a tiny figure at its centre.
Image 2: Dr. Seuss Midnight Painting: swooping organic lobes, curling stalks with flag leaves and pale thin contour on black.
Image 3: the Clawd companion: take only its stubby blocky body, flat plates and small dark slit marks as the cast property.
Image 4: owner card MFJFTELGH6FD8: a single radiant core behind a flat silhouette, the shape never whites out.
VARIANT muse-03 'Pop-star bubble': A bubble with a lobed Seuss skin that bulges unevenly; on the pop it bursts into pointed star shards radiating like a burst. The design sits between clawd (blocky plates as the shards) and the Seuss paintings.
